archetypes.name: dyn-step3-routing
archetypes.rationale: NEXT_ACTION now drives Step 3 routing across loop, normalizer, and MAV retally paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 NEXT_ACTION mapping and persistence across normalize-status, loop envelope writes, zero-findings degraded paths, and MAV retally. Verify that terminal routes emit and persist deterministic actions while mid-loop retally ok remains action-free. Check that prompt prose and harness pins no longer reconstruct routing from raw status fields. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
